channel.title: The Dig — Calibration, tuning and drift
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Calibration, tuning and drift preset. Today’s ranked reading list collects six relevance-3 skims that sit around the edges of neutral-atom and spin-qubit control, QEC, and HPC integration: 2611.17652 on an FPGA-based quantum data processing unit, 2611.17262 on scalable Pauli propagation, 2611.16971 on benchmarked-noise zero-noise extrapolation, 2611.18378 on structure and trainability in quantum circuits, 2611.16285 on multi-GPU orchestration for relay belief-propagation decoding, and 2611.16271 on hierarchical QEC decoding. Together they are useful for transferable methods and infrastructure context rather than direct spin-qubit operation, calibration, or benchmarking.
